description_en: Closes the database engine migration process for a specified instance. After a user starts a data migration task from another database (such as a self-managed MySQL or ApsaraDB RDS instance) to PolarDB-X, this operation can be called to safely stop the migration process if the migration needs to be terminated or the migration state needs to be cleaned up
description_zh: 此接口用于关闭指定实例的数据库引擎迁移流程。当用户启动从其他数据库（如自建 MySQL、RDS 等）向 PolarDB-X 的数据迁移任务后，若需中途终止或清理迁移状态，可通过此接口安全停止迁移过程
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx close-engine-migration --db-instance-name pxc-htri00000r4k9p --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --continue-enable-binlog true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloseEngineMigration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to keep binlog enabled. Valid values:

true: Keeps binlog enabled.
false: Disables binlog.

Default value: true.

Disabling binlog will restart your PolarDB cluster
parameters.help_zh:
是否继续打开Binlog，取值范围如下： 
true：继续打开Binlog
false：关闭Binlog

默认取值为true。 

关闭Binlog将会重启您的PolarDB集群
parameters.name: continue_enable_binlog
